reviews.title: Client Feedback
reviews.subtitle: What creators say about working together

items.a: Short-form videos (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) — from $20, long-form videos (YouTube, podcasts) — from $80 and up. Pricing depends on duration and motion design depth. For batch orders of 10+ videos, a 15–20% discount applies, and I reserve a dedicated production slot for your channel.

A single short-form video (Reels/Shorts) takes 24 to 48 hours once raw footage is received. A batch of 10 videos is delivered on a planned schedule — 2–3 finished videos every two days to keep your content calendar uninterrupted.

items.q: What do you need from me to get started?
items.a: Raw footage (via Google Drive, Frame.io, or Dropbox), a brief note about the task, and 1–2 video references for pacing/style. If you don't have a full script or brief, I'll help outline the structure and propose visual hooks.

For one-off projects: 50% deposit, 50% upon watermark preview approval. For recurring batch work, milestone-based billing is available. I accept bank transfers (Kaspi, Freedom), international payments (Payoneer), crypto (USDT), or freelance escrow contracts.

items.q: What if I need revisions or want changes?
items.a: Every video includes 2 rounds of timecode-based revisions. We align on visual style during the first draft or test video, ensuring the final output matches expectations.
I provide a short 10–15 second test cut when discussing long-term partnerships or video bundles. For single one-off orders, test edits are paid and credited toward the total project invoice.

items.q: Who chooses music, SFX, and fonts — could there be copyright strikes?
items.a: I handle the full package: sound design, transitions, color grading, and dynamic subtitles. I use licensed music and trending royalty-safe audio optimized for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok to prevent copyright strikes.

items.q: Do you deliver project source files (Project Files)?
items.a: By default, I deliver final renders in maximum resolution (4K/1080p, 60 fps). Handover of raw project files (After Effects / Premiere Pro / DaVinci) with all packaged assets can be arranged for an additional fee.
